message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The doctor prevented the core medication hazard by repeatedly distinguishing “必要时围手术期抗凝处理” from a home prescription and by directing the family to verify actual medication instructions with the surgical/anesthesia team. The trajectory also established an executable handoff plan, monitored red flags, contextualized the lung nodule as annual follow-up rather than a reason to derail surgery, and obtained caregiver receipt. At least two high-order actions were completed with meaningful impact: verifying real medication orders through drug boxes/clinician review and adapting the plan to family confusion with written scripts/bedside notes.
